jobs.title: #Backend Software Engineer
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering General Summary: ***This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship*** As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what’s possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Backend Software Engineer on the Snapdragon Guardian / Compute Sentra team, you will help build the cloud services that power out-of-band device management and IoT security for our customers’ fleets — designing, developing, and validating the microservices, APIs, and event pipelines that keep devices secure, discoverable, and manageable at scale. This is an entry-level role ideal for a recent graduate or early-career engineer who wants to grow their backend skills on a modern, cloud-native platform alongside experienced engineers. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. As a Backend Software Engineer, you will: Work with a group of talented engineers to build and maintain backend microservices for the Compute Sentra SaaS platform. Implement REST APIs, event listeners, and data models under the guidance of senior engineers. Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to learn and uphold team standards. Be exposed to modern AI-assisted software development, using AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging as part of our everyday engineering workflow. Help troubleshoot, debug, and monitor services running in our cloud environment. Collaborate with cross-functional teammates — product, QA, and other engineers — to deliver features end to end. Minimum Qualifications: B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Foundational programming experience in an object-oriented language (Java, Kotlin, C#, or similar), through coursework, internships, or personal projects. Familiarity with relational databases and SQL fundamentals. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Fluent English. Must be able to work on-site in San Diego, CA. Preferred Qualifications — What you will bring: Exposure to server-side frameworks such as Spring / Spring Boot (Java) or equivalents (Flask, FastAPI, .NET). Understanding of REST API design and HTTP fundamentals. Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows. Basic understanding of microservices architecture. Any exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Nice to Haves: Excellent problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn. Any exposure to working with AI coding assistants such as Claude or Codex. Coursework or projects involving distributed systems, messaging (Kafka), or event-driven design. Familiarity with PostgreSQL or other relational databases. Exposure to containers and Kubernetes (Docker, k8s). Awareness of Clean Code, SOLID, and sound software engineering practices. Interest in IoT, device management, or security. Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here . Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Kiro
jobs.description: The future of software development is agentic. AWS is building Kiro — a frontier AI coding agent that tackles development tasks end-to-end, retains context across complex workflows, and continuously learns from its work. Kiro is already transforming how developers build and maintain software, and we're just getting started. We're looking for engineers who want to shape this transformation. You'll work alongside exceptional talent solving novel problems at the intersection of AI and software engineering. The challenges are unique: orchestrating AI workflows across dozens of models, building context systems that make every interaction smarter than the last, and scaling it all to meet AWS's exacting standards for reliability and security. Your impact will be immediate and visible. You'll ship features that directly improve how developers work — from launching new models in hours, to building intelligent routing, to designing the context layer that makes Kiro genuinely understand your project. These aren't incremental improvements; they're the building blocks of a new category of developer tool. From day one, you'll have opportunities to lead — whether that's owning a critical system, defining technical direction for a new capability, or shaping how the team operates. You'll work across distributed systems, real-time streaming, multi-model orchestration, and AI infrastructure at scale. The team is small enough that your decisions matter and large enough that you'll always have someone to learn from. This is your chance to build the agent that builds the future.
